Auth.signInSubtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to your account.
Auth.signUpSubtitle: Track your orders and check out faster.
Auth.name: Full name
Auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
Auth.accountNote: The full account dashboard is built in a later step.
Auth.verifySentTo: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
Auth.verifySentGeneric: Enter your email and we will send you a new verification link.
Auth.verifySpamHint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder.
Auth.resent: If an account exists for this email, a new link is on its way.
Auth.verifyDoneBody: Thanks! Your email address is confirmed and you are signed in.
Auth.verifyFailedBody: This verification link is no longer valid. Request a new one below.
Auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
Auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for 1 hour.
Auth.resetSubtitle: Pick a strong password you do not use anywhere else.
Auth.resetInvalidBody: Reset links work once and expire after 1 hour.
Auth.passwordResetDone: Your password was updated. Please sign in with your new password.
Auth.verifySocial: We sent a verification link to the email on your account. Open it to finish signing in. Didn't get it? Enter your email below.

errors.nameLength: Name must be between 2 and 80 characters.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordWeak: Password needs at least one letter and one number.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.accountNotLinked: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with your password (or reset it), then connect Google or Facebook from your account security settings.
errors.socialNoEmail: Facebook did not share an email address with us. Please allow email access, or sign up with your email instead.
errors.socialFailed: We could not complete sign-in with that provider. Please try again.
errors.socialStaffNotAllowed: Staff accounts must sign in with email and password.

TwoFactor.challengeSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.backupSubtitle: Enter one of your backup codes. Each code works once.
TwoFactor.otpSubtitle: We will send a 6-digit code to the email address on your account.
TwoFactor.codeSent: A code was sent to your email. It expires in a few minutes.
TwoFactor.securitySubtitle: Protect your account with two-step verification.
TwoFactor.scanBody: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…), add an account, and scan this code.
TwoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
TwoFactor.secretWarn: Treat this key like a password.
TwoFactor.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app to finish.
TwoFactor.backupBody: Each code works once. Use one if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
TwoFactor.savedCheck: I saved these codes in a safe place
TwoFactor.regenerateBody: Confirm your password. All your old backup codes will stop working.
TwoFactor.disableBody: Confirm your password to turn two-step verification off.
TwoFactor.staffRequired: Staff accounts must keep two-step verification turned on.
TwoFactor.noPasswordTitle: You sign in with Google or Facebook
TwoFactor.noPasswordBody: Your account has no password. Two-step verification protects email-and-password sign-in only, so please secure your Google or Facebook account instead.
TwoFactor.requiredBanner: Staff accounts must turn on two-step verification before using the admin area.

errors.codeInvalid: Enter the code exactly as shown.
errors.wrongCode: That code is not correct. Try again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts. This account is temporarily locked. Try again later.
errors.otpNotAllowed: Email codes are not available for staff accounts. Use your authenticator app or a backup code.
errors.sessionExpired: Your sign-in session expired. Please sign in again.

Security.connectedBody: The ways you can sign in to your account.
Security.lastMethod: You can't remove your only sign-in method.
Security.staffNoSocial: Staff accounts sign in with email and password only.
